definitions.gloss: Mito; capital city of Ibaraki Prefecture
definitions.explanation: A city northeast of Tokyo, known historically as the seat of the Mito branch of the Tokugawa clan and today famous for {納豆|なっとう} (fermented soybeans) and the {偕楽園|かいらくえん} plum garden.

examples.japanese: {水戸|みと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{水戸|みと}⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Mito natto is famous throughout the country.
In spring, Kairakuen Garden in Mito bustles with people who come to see the plum blossoms.

notes:
Proper noun. Mito was the home of the Mito Tokugawa, one of the three branches ({御三家|ごさんけ}) of the Tokugawa family, and is the setting of the long-running TV series {水戸黄門|みとこうもん}.

COMMON ASSOCIATIONS:
- {水戸|みと}⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧: Mito natto — the city is the symbolic home of natto
- {水戸|みと}{黄門|こうもん}: Mito Kōmon — historical drama protagonist
- {偕楽園|かいらくえん}: Kairakuen — one of the Three Great Gardens of Japan, in Mito
